تقتنون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَنُونَ (taqtanūna) /taq.ta.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# تُقْتَنَوْنَ (tuqtanawna) /tuq.ta.naw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
